inv.desc_es:
Local comercial esquinero en Arrancapins, Valencia

Local comercial situado en el barrio de Arrancapins, Valencia, en una ubicación esquinera que destaca por su visibilidad y luminosidad.

Dispone de 85 m2 construidos y 65 m2 útiles, distribuidos en dos estancias. Cuenta con dos escaparates, baño y una distribución versátil, ideal para diferentes tipos de actividad comercial o profesional.

Local exterior, reformado y con orientación suroeste, que favorece la entrada de luz natural.

Precio de venta: 199.999 €

Alquiler con opción a compra

* Precio de compraventa: 199.999 €
* Alquiler mensual: 1.100 € + IVA
* Plazo máximo: 24 meses

Dos modalidades de entrada:

* Entrada de 40.000 €: se descontará del precio final el 50 % de las rentas de alquiler abonadas durante el periodo establecido.
* Entrada de 60.000 €: se descontará del precio final el 100 % de las rentas de alquiler abonadas durante el periodo establecido.

Las condiciones definitivas, los importes que se descontarán del precio de compraventa y el plazo para ejercer la opción se establecerán en el contrato.

Una excelente oportunidad para emprender, establecer tu negocio o invertir en una zona consolidada de Valencia.

inv.desc_en:
Corner commercial premises in Arrancapins, Valencia

Commercial premises located in the Arrancapins neighborhood, Valencia, in a corner location that stands out for its visibility and brightness.

It has 85 m2 built and 65 m2 of usable space, distributed into two rooms. It features two display windows, a bathroom, and a versatile layout, ideal for different types of commercial or professional activity.

Exterior premises, renovated and with a southwest orientation, which favors the entry of natural light.

Sale price: €199,999

Rent-to-own option

* Sale price: €199,999
* Monthly rent: €1,100 + VAT
* Maximum term: 24 months

Two down payment options:

* €40,000 down payment: 50% of the rent paid during the established period will be deducted from the final price.
* €60,000 down payment: 100% of the rent paid during the established period will be deducted from the final price.

The final conditions, the amounts to be deducted from the sale price, and the deadline to exercise the option will be established in the contract.

An excellent opportunity to start a business, establish your company, or invest in a consolidated area of Valencia.

VISIT US AT CASAREAL GRUPO INMOBILIARIO
Avda. Cortes Valencianas, 118 Tavernes Blanques.

Legal Guarantee:
This real estate agency is duly registered in the Registry of Real Estate Intermediation Agents of the Valencian Community under number RAICV 3516. We have the mandatory Civil Liability and Surety insurance required by current regulations to guarantee total security.
